Review_Text: The app keeps crashing whenever load shedding hits. So frustrating.
Sent money to my flatmate and it reflected instantly. Excellent.
The consultant helped me order a new bank card in ten minutes. Great service.
The ATM at the mall kept my card on payday. Absolutely disgusting.
Monthly fees went up with no warning at all. I am so disappointed.
My EFT to a supplier sat pending for two days. Terrible for my business.
Month-end queue was out the door but the tellers were friendly and fast.
Withdrew R200 for the week. The machine was out of R10 notes.
Biometric login works every time now. Smooth and quick.
Instant EFT limit is too low for my payroll. Very annoying.
I waited 40 minutes just to withdraw my pension. Terrible experience.
Cardless cash withdrawal at the ATM worked perfectly. Love this feature.
The app logged me out twice while paying for data. Frustrating.
Paid the school fees online, cleared same day. Easy and painless.
Opened my business account in one visit. The consultant was brilliant.
ATM was out of cash the whole weekend. Had to drive to three machines, terrible.
App down again during stage 4 load shedding. Third time this month, awful.
Queue on grant day was long but the security guard helped us, very kind.
Payment to my car dealer reflected in seconds. Fantastic.
Cannot upload invoices on the app. Useless for business banking.
My card was cloned at a sketchy ATM. I am so angry about this.
The branch closed early without notice. Wasted trip, very annoying.
Batch payments cleared overnight without any issues. Great work.
The font on the app is too small for me. Struggled to read my balance.
Withdrew cash for the weekend braai, no issues at all.
Notifications for every swipe are so helpful for budgeting. Love it.
Tellers could not process my deposit slip properly. Disappointed with the service.
Called the contact centre and the agent sorted my dispute in one call. Excellent.
Held for 25 minutes on the phone then got cut off. Disgusting.
The lady on the phone was patient, kind and brilliant with my reversal. Excellent service.
Nobody at the contact centre understands merchant codes. Useless.
WhatsApp banking answered my balance query in seconds. Impressive.
The WhatsApp chatbot kept looping the same menu. So frustrating.
Blocked my lost card through WhatsApp in two minutes. Brilliant.
I do not understand the WhatsApp banking prompts. Confusing for me.
Deposited my weekend takings at the ATM. Receipt printed and done.
My transfer to myself took two days to clear. Annoying.
The new statements view is clean and easy to read. Great improvement.
Branch consultant opened my tax-free savings account quickly. Happy with the service.
Moved R500 from my current account to my savings at the teller.
